snippet.title: Battleship Command – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367430/Battleship_Command

Step aboard the mighty Scharnhorst in Battleship Command, an immersive WWII naval simulation from MicroProse and Bracer. Walk the decks, issue orders, take control of radar and gunnery systems, and experience detailed, dynamic naval warfare across the Atlantic, Arctic, and Mediterranean.

Every shell, every wave, and every decision counts in this authentic and cinematic battleship experience. Watch the full announcement trailer for your first look.

#MicroProse #BattleshipCommand #WWII #NavalWarfare #SimulationGames #Wargame #PCGaming
